summary: All 8 acceptance-matrix criteria exercised: 12 backend pytest cases (5 files) + 7 browser checks (one run twice, once on localhost and once through the public APP_URL ingress). Everything passed: 14/14 freeze invariants confirmed via scripts/check_freeze_invariants.py, API, and UI; all 5 Kiltikonet registries (17/13/10/8/6 rows) verified server-side and rendered client-side; contradiction register OPEN with KC-001 present; v1.0 corpus (145 docs, 87 v1.0 docs) and freeze text untouched with no Kiltikonet mentions; patch/audit docs and 18 decisions (D-015..D-018) traceable with working ADR links; existing v1.1 views (overview, matrix, gaps, architecture, graph, search) load with zero HTTP >= 400 and render Mermaid SVG + counts.
